Copied: Copied. Paste into your editor or terminal.
ClipboardUnavailable: Clipboard unavailable. Try again or select and copy the source manually.
InvalidNames: Start with A–Z, followed by letters or digits. Showing the raw template until both names are valid.
TemplateDescription: Actual CLI list templates. Preview names before copying the complete source.
DemoDescription: The running example, including XAML layout, lifecycle hooks and data services.
DataSourceDescription: Complete XAML and code behind for the data example.
LifetimeHelp: Enter a query and switch pages. Compare actual callbacks and IDs (latest 20 per page type). OnDestroy is framework cleanup, not proof of garbage collection.
IntegrationIntro: Run each command from an existing project root. New to XamlNexus? Start with Getting started.
ListStep1: Create a Projects page. Choose another name if it already exists.
ListStep2: Open ProjectsPage.xaml and its code-behind in <YourApp>.MainPanel. Implement IProjectsDataSource in Services/ProjectsDataSource.cs, then pass it to ProjectsViewModel.
DataStep1: Preview and add SQLite storage to your project.
DataStep2: Use IDbContextFactory<AppDbContext> from the generated Data project. The component provides storage; adapt this example to your own records and services.
DataCheck: Save a test record, close the app, restart and read it back. Verify database persistence and KeepAlive page retention separately.
ListCheck: Run Projects and check search, refresh and empty results. Gallery simulation switches are not generated by the CLI.
CachedCheck: Enter a query, leave and return: query and data remain. Restarting does not preserve this in-memory state.
ListDescription: Search a data-bound list and explore async loading, cancellation and failure recovery.
ListExampleTitle: A searchable list with async loading
PersistenceHelp: KeepAlive retains the page in the current process; it does not restore data after restarting. Implement the generated data-source interface for business data.
TryRegular: Search for WinUI, enable a slow request or simulate a failure, then refresh. Use Page retention to explore navigation state.
TryCached: Search for WinUI, switch to Home, then return. The query, results and page ID stay the same.
HomeDescription: Explore working examples. Understand the pattern. Use it in your app.
HomeTip: Start with Lists & async loading for data interactions. Page retention demonstrates state across navigation; Data & recovery demonstrates persistence across restarts.
GettingStartedDescription: From environment checks to your first working page.
EnvironmentHelp: doctor checks local configuration. Build and run a project to verify the complete toolchain. Stop the app before rebuilding.
ThemeHelp: Choose a light or dark appearance.
AboutDescription: Interactive examples and source templates for desktop apps.
DataDescription: Edit local records, create backups and restore a database.
DataTry: Save a key/value pair, select it to edit, then create a backup. Restoring a backup replaces database contents and asks for confirmation.
DataStateHelp: SQLite persists saved records across restarts. KeepAlive retains page state in the current process and does not save edits to the database.
LifetimeDescription: Keep query and loaded data when navigating away. Compare page instances and lifecycle callbacks with the uncached list.
BackupHelp: Create a snapshot before making changes. Restore replaces the saved database after confirmation.
